test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: D, E, F, G, H, I and P are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between D and P when counted from the right of D. D sits third to the left of H. G sits third to the left of E. I is an immediate neighbour of both P and H. How many people sit between F and I when counted from the right of F?
solution:
Given: D, E, F, G, H, I and P are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only four people sit between D and P when counted from the right of D.

2) D sits third to the left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3b6b58694ce1ffa08ecdccca6c9ba47d8005a2a0439902669c9dea991c3300c.png] 

3) I is an immediate neighbour of both P and H.

4) G sits third to the left of E.

After positioning P, G and E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39f661632e407582317b7a604bbca254b3a63c2d8efa762a243a12307a45d29b.png] 

Thus, two people sit between F and I when counted from the right of F.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
